title: SSLHandler Removal Exceptions
body:
I use SSL as my form of server to server authentication in a back-end configuration. When I remove or close the SSL Handler so that I can make my connection unsecured once authenticated. I keep getting exceptions and I have tried this in multiple ways on both the client and server.  My handlers and pipeline...

```
p.addFirst("ssl",  sslCtx.newHandler(c.alloc()));
p.addAfter("ssl", "chunked-writer", new ChunkedWriteHandler());
p.addAfter("chunked-writer", "decoder", decoder); // ByteToMessageDecoder (Anonymous... ommitted)
```
- First I tried removing the handler on both ends after handshake success.

```
  sslHandler.handshakeFuture().addListener(channelFuture -> {
       if (channelFuture.isSuccess()) {
           p.remove(sslHandler);
           ChannelFuture future = c.writeAndFlush(PooledByteBufAllocator.DEFAULT.directBuffer().writeInt(DEVELOPMENT_FILE_SERVER_MAGIC_NUMBER));
        }
   });
```

- Second I tried closing the handler first then removing it. 

```
    sslHandler.handshakeFuture().addListener(channelFuture -> {
        if (channelFuture.isSuccess()) {
            ChannelFuture close = sslHandler.close();
            close.addListeners(new ChannelFutureListener() {

                @Override
                 public void operationComplete(final ChannelFuture channelFuture) throws Exception {
                     p.remove(sslHandler);
                     ChannelFuture future = c.writeAndFlush(PooledByteBufAllocator.DEFAULT.directBuffer().writeInt(DEVELOPMENT_FILE_SERVER_MAGIC_NUMBER));
             }
     });
```
